#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Independent re-run of ACT-EFFORT-HIGH-2, read-only against the bundle; all writes under $TMPDIR."""
import hashlib, json, os, shutil, stat, subprocess, sys

T = os.environ["TMPDIR"]
REPO = "/home/usain/Dynamic-Agentic-Engineering-OS"
REALHOME = "/home/usain"
B = REPO + "/.gov-runtime/scratch/orchestrator/acts/ACT-EFFORT-HIGH-2"
CLONE = T + "/clone"
OPD = REPO + "/governance/project/operator"
fails = 0


def ok(cond, msg):
    global fails
    print(("ok   " if cond else "FAIL ") + msg)
    if not cond:
        fails += 1


def sha(p):
    return hashlib.sha256(open(p, "rb").read()).hexdigest()


def env_for(home):
    e = {k: os.environ[k] for k in ("PATH", "LANG", "USER", "LOGNAME", "TMPDIR") if k in os.environ}
    e["HOME"] = home
    e["PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE"] = "1"
    return e


def run(cmd, home, script=B + "/apply.sh", extra=None):
    env = env_for(home)
    env.update(extra or {})
    if isinstance(cmd, str) and cmd in ("check", "apply", "undo", "verify"):
        argv = ["bash", script, cmd]
    else:
        argv = ["bash", "-c", cmd]
    p = subprocess.run(argv, cwd=CLONE, env=env, capture_output=True)
    return p.returncode, p.stdout.decode(), p.stderr.decode()


def plant(name, src=B + "/before/home/.claude/settings.json", mode=0o644):
    h = os.path.join(T, "homes", name)
    shutil.rmtree(h, ignore_errors=True)
    os.makedirs(h + "/.claude")
    shutil.copyfile(src, h + "/.claude/settings.json")
    os.chmod(h + "/.claude/settings.json", mode)
    return h


def walk(h):
    out = {}
    for top, ds, fs in os.walk(h):
        for f in fs:
            p = os.path.join(top, f)
            out[os.path.relpath(p, h)] = (sha(p), stat.S_IMODE(os.lstat(p).st_mode))
    return out


m = json.load(open(B + "/manifest.json"))
BEFORE = m["touched"][0]["before"]
AFTER = m["touched"][0]["after"]
bundle_before = {r: sha(os.path.join(B, r)) for r in list(m["files"]) + ["manifest.json"]}
live_before = sha(REALHOME + "/.claude/settings.json")

print("--- hashes")
ok(sha(B + "/manifest.json") == "0be009e84c86c22c8f1e62ff63289912cf16d225f8207b22285d76d0980d0ac8", "manifest sha as stated")
for rel, want in m["files"].items():
    ok(sha(os.path.join(B, rel)) == want, f"files: {rel} hashes as listed")
found = sorted(os.path.relpath(os.path.join(t, f), B) for t, _, fs in os.walk(B) for f in fs)
ok(sorted(set(found) - {"manifest.json", "review.md"}) == sorted(m["files"]), "bundle holds exactly the listed files")
ok(open(B + "/list.txt").read().strip() == f"home|.claude/settings.json|{BEFORE}|{AFTER}", "list.txt matches touched")
ok(live_before == BEFORE, "live settings file is the frozen before (read only)")

print("--- operator code (read-only import)")
sys.dont_write_bytecode = True
sys.path.insert(0, OPD)
import operator_run as orun  # noqa
import act_class  # noqa
try:
    orun.validate_manifest(m)
    ok(True, "validate_manifest passes")
except Exception as e:
    ok(False, f"validate_manifest: {e}")
s = {"repo": REPO, "home": REALHOME}
try:
    orun.path_rule(B, m, s)
    ok(True, "path_rule passes against the live repo and real HOME")
except Exception as e:
    ok(False, f"path_rule: {e}")
c = act_class.classify(B)
print("     classify:", json.dumps(c)[:400])
ok(c["class"] == "b", "act_class.classify gives (b)")

print("--- dry-run shape: clean env, cwd = clone, planted HOME, no backup")
h = plant("dry")
a = walk(h)
git_a = subprocess.run(["git", "status", "--porcelain", "--ignored"], cwd=CLONE, capture_output=True).stdout
rc, o, e = run("check", h); ok(rc == 0 and "state before" in o, f"check before: {rc} {o.strip()}{e.strip()}")
for i, ck in enumerate(m["checks"]):
    rc, o, e = run(ck["cmd"], h)
    want = 1 if i == 0 else 0
    ok(rc == want, f"check {i} on the before copy: exit {rc} (want {want}) {e.strip()[-120:]}")
rc, o, e = run("verify", h); ok(rc == 3, f"verify before apply refused: {rc}")
rc, o, e = run("apply", h); ok(rc == 0 and "state applied" in o, f"apply: {rc} {o.strip()}{e.strip()}")
b = walk(h)
changed = sorted(k for k in set(a) | set(b) if a.get(k) != b.get(k))
ok(changed == [".claude/settings.json"], f"changed set in HOME: {changed}")
ok(b[".claude/settings.json"] == (AFTER, 0o644), "result hashes as after, mode 644 kept")
for i, ck in enumerate(m["checks"]):
    rc, o, e = run(ck["cmd"], h)
    ok(rc == ck["exit"] and orun.check_ok(ck, rc, o.encode()), f"check {i} after apply: exit {rc}")
rc, o, e = run("verify", h); ok(rc == 0, f"verify after apply: {rc}")
rc, o, e = run("check", h); ok(rc == 0 and "state applied" in o, f"check after apply: {o.strip()}")
rc, o, e = run("apply", h); ok(rc == 0 and "nothing to do" in o and walk(h) == b, "second apply: no change")
rc, o, e = run("undo", h); ok(rc == 0 and "state before" in o, f"undo: {rc} {o.strip()}")
d = walk(h)
ok(d == a, "after undo the planted HOME is byte for byte as before (and mode)")
ok(open(h + "/.claude/settings.json", "rb").read() == open(B + "/before/home/.claude/settings.json", "rb").read(), "undo: cmp with before copy identical")
rc, o, e = run("undo", h); ok(rc == 0 and "nothing to undo" in o, "second undo harmless")
git_b = subprocess.run(["git", "status", "--porcelain", "--ignored"], cwd=CLONE, capture_output=True).stdout
ok(git_a == git_b, "the clone's tree is unchanged by the run")

print("--- the diff, parsed")
bj = json.load(open(B + "/before/home/.claude/settings.json"))
aj = json.load(open(B + "/after/home/.claude/settings.json"))
exp = json.loads(json.dumps(bj))
exp["effortLevel"] = "high"
exp["modelSettings"]["claude-sonnet-5-5"] = {"effortLevel": "high"}
ok(aj == exp and list(aj) == list(bj) and list(aj["modelSettings"]) == ["claude-opus-5-5", "claude-sonnet-5-5"], "after = before + the two intended changes only, key order kept")
ok(aj.get("hooks") == bj.get("hooks") and aj["permissions"] == bj["permissions"] and aj["env"] == bj["env"], "permissions, env, hooks unchanged")
reform = (json.dumps(aj, indent=2) + "\n").encode()
ok(reform == open(B + "/after/home/.claude/settings.json", "rb").read(), "after copy is the canonical indent-2 layout (as Claude Code writes it)")

print("--- state by sha256 alone")
h = plant("mode600", mode=0o600)
rc, o, e = run("apply", h); ok(rc == 0 and stat.S_IMODE(os.stat(h + "/.claude/settings.json").st_mode) == 0o600, "mode 600 kept by apply")
rc, o, e = run("undo", h); ok(rc == 0 and stat.S_IMODE(os.stat(h + "/.claude/settings.json").st_mode) == 0o600 and sha(h + "/.claude/settings.json") == BEFORE, "mode 600 kept by undo, bytes before")
h = plant("drift")
p = h + "/.claude/settings.json"
open(p, "ab").write(b" ")
dsha = sha(p)
for st in ("check", "apply", "undo"):
    rc, o, e = run(st, h); ok(rc == 3 and sha(p) == dsha, f"drift (+1 byte, top-level still xhigh): {st} exit {rc}, file untouched")
ok(sorted(os.listdir(h + "/.claude")) == ["settings.json"], "no temp or backup left beside the drifted file")
h = plant("crlf")
p = h + "/.claude/settings.json"
open(p, "wb").write(open(B + "/before/home/.claude/settings.json", "rb").read().replace(b"\n", b"\r\n"))
rc, o, e = run("apply", h); ok(rc == 3, f"same JSON, other bytes (CRLF): apply refused {rc}")
h = plant("minus1", src=B + "/before/home/.claude/settings.json")
p = h + "/.claude/settings.json"
open(p, "wb").write(open(p, "rb").read().replace(b'"effortLevel": "xhigh"', b'"effortLevel": "high"'))
rc, o, e = run("check", h); ok(rc == 3, f"the -1 after (top-level high, no sonnet entry): check {rc}")
rc, o, e = run("apply", h); ok(rc == 3, f"the -1 after: apply {rc}")
h = os.path.join(T, "homes", "missing"); shutil.rmtree(h, ignore_errors=True); os.makedirs(h)
for st in ("check", "apply", "undo"):
    rc, o, e = run(st, h); ok(rc != 0 and not os.path.exists(h + "/.claude/settings.json"), f"missing file: {st} exit {rc}, nothing created")
h = os.path.join(T, "homes", "dir"); shutil.rmtree(h, ignore_errors=True); os.makedirs(h + "/.claude/settings.json")
rc, o, e = run("apply", h); ok(rc == 3, f"a directory at the path: apply {rc}")
h = plant("link")
os.rename(h + "/.claude/settings.json", h + "/.claude/real.json"); os.symlink("real.json", h + "/.claude/settings.json")
rc, o, e = run("apply", h); ok(rc == 3 and sha(h + "/.claude/real.json") == BEFORE, f"a link (to a before copy): apply {rc}, target untouched")
rc, o, e = run("undo", h); ok(rc == 3, f"a link: undo {rc}")
h = plant("applied-link", src=B + "/after/home/.claude/settings.json")
os.rename(h + "/.claude/settings.json", h + "/.claude/real.json"); os.symlink("real.json", h + "/.claude/settings.json")
rc, o, e = run("undo", h); ok(rc == 3 and sha(h + "/.claude/real.json") == AFTER, f"a link to an after copy: undo {rc}, target untouched")
p = subprocess.run(["env", "-u", "HOME", "bash", B + "/apply.sh", "check"], cwd=CLONE, capture_output=True,
                   env={k: v for k, v in env_for("x").items() if k != "HOME"})
ok(p.returncode != 0, f"HOME unset: refused ({p.returncode})")
rc, o, e = run("bogus", plant("u")) if False else (None, None, None)
p = subprocess.run(["bash", B + "/apply.sh", "bogus"], cwd=CLONE, capture_output=True, env=env_for(plant("u")))
ok(p.returncode == 2, f"unknown step: usage, exit {p.returncode}")

print("--- tampered frozen copies (on a copy of the bundle)")
bc = os.path.join(T, "bcopy"); shutil.rmtree(bc, ignore_errors=True); shutil.copytree(B, bc)
for r, _, fs in os.walk(bc):
    for f in fs:
        os.chmod(os.path.join(r, f), 0o644)
open(bc + "/after/home/.claude/settings.json", "ab").write(b"x")
h = plant("tamperA")
rc, o, e = run("apply", h, script=bc + "/apply.sh"); ok(rc == 4 and sha(h + "/.claude/settings.json") == BEFORE and sorted(os.listdir(h + "/.claude")) == ["settings.json"], f"tampered after copy: apply {rc}, untouched")
shutil.copyfile(B + "/after/home/.claude/settings.json", bc + "/after/home/.claude/settings.json")
open(bc + "/before/home/.claude/settings.json", "ab").write(b"x")
h = plant("tamperB", src=B + "/after/home/.claude/settings.json")
rc, o, e = run("undo", h, script=bc + "/apply.sh"); ok(rc == 4 and sha(h + "/.claude/settings.json") == AFTER, f"tampered before copy: undo {rc}, untouched")

print("--- ACT_BACKUP_BESIDE=1 (hand run only)")
h = plant("bak")
rc, o, e = run("apply", h, extra={"ACT_BACKUP_BESIDE": "1"})
names = sorted(os.listdir(h + "/.claude"))
ok(rc == 0 and len(names) == 2 and any(n.startswith("settings.json.bak-") and n.endswith("-ACT-EFFORT-HIGH-2") for n in names), f"backup beside: {names}")
ok(orun.oc.clean_env(s, "/x").get("ACT_BACKUP_BESIDE") is None, "the agent's clean_env drops ACT_BACKUP_BESIDE")

print("--- nothing outside TMPDIR changed")
ok({r: sha(os.path.join(B, r)) for r in bundle_before} == bundle_before, "bundle files unchanged")
ok(sorted(set(os.path.relpath(os.path.join(t, f), B) for t, _, fs in os.walk(B) for f in fs)) == found, "no file added to the bundle")
ok(sha(REALHOME + "/.claude/settings.json") == live_before, "live ~/.claude/settings.json unchanged")
print(f"failures: {fails}")
